compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.hintLossless: Re-packs the file and removes metadata. Text, vectors and form fields stay selectable.
compress.hintLossy: Renders every page to an image at the chosen resolution. Much smaller for scans, but the text is no longer selectable or searchable.

help.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
help.ctrlCNote: * Ctrl+C copies the selected annotation element. If PDF text is selected, the browser's native copy takes precedence instead.

lockPdf.userPasswordLabel: Open password (required to open the PDF)
lockPdf.locked: PDF will be locked on next export.

ocr.title: Recognize text (OCR)
ocr.modeSearchable: Searchable layer — keep the scan, make it selectable (recommended)
ocr.modeVisible: Editable text boxes (overlay — for clean pages, not scans)
ocr.hint: Recognizes text on the current page. “Searchable layer” keeps the scan exactly as-is and adds invisible, selectable text over it. Language data is downloaded on first use.

sign.title: Sign PDF
sign.genTrustNote: A generated certificate is self-signed: the signature is cryptographically valid, but readers (e.g. Adobe) show "validity unknown" until they explicitly trust it. The .p12 and .pem are downloaded so you can reuse and share them.
sign.positionLabel: Signature box (points: X, Y, width, height)
sign.nameLabel: Signer name (optional, defaults to certificate name)
sign.signatureImageLabel: Your drawn signature (shown in the signature box)
sign.privacyNote: Your certificate never leaves your browser. The signature covers your current edits and annotations.

signers.title: Add approval signature
signers.hint: Fill in the signer, then draw the signature and click on the page to place it. Repeat for each signer. Each signer can export the PDF and send it to the next; apply the digital seal (🔏) last — re-exporting after sealing invalidates it. Visible signatures are an approval stamp, not cryptographic proof.
